related.title: Mir 模組化太空站
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若教學外部吸熱上限 3000 W，遮罩案通過此分項，但仍需完整暫態熱模型。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a 3000 W teaching external-input limit, the cover passes this allocation but still requires a full transient model. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 比較單一路徑與雙冗餘路徑的通訊可用度，顯示共因故障的影響。
related.differenceEn: Compare communication availability of single and redundant paths while exposing common-cause effects.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成太陽照度 1360 W/m²、受照面積 10 m²、吸收率 0.6、正對太陽。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Q=0.6×1360×10。 結果約 8160 W。直接日照吸熱 Q=αSAcosθ；只算外部輸入，不等於艙內溫度。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學兩條資料路徑各可用度 0.98，先假設完全獨立且電源理想。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：A=1−0.02²。 結果約 0.9996 fraction。獨立並聯兩路可用度 A=1−(1−a)²；若共用電源，需再乘其可用度。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic irradiance is 1360 W/m², exposed area 10 m², absorptivity 0.6 and normal incidence. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Q=0.6×1360×10. Result ≈ 8160 W. Direct solar absorption Q=αSAcosθ calculates input only, not cabin temperature.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Each of two teaching data paths has availability 0.98, initially assuming independence and ideal power. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: A=1−0.02². Result ≈ 0.9996 fraction. Two independent parallel paths have A=1−(1−a)²; a shared power source multiplies the result by its availability.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Iridium 衛星通訊系統
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若教學外部吸熱上限 3000 W，遮罩案通過此分項，但仍需完整暫態熱模型。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a 3000 W teaching external-input limit, the cover passes this allocation but still requires a full transient model. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 估算獨立嘗試的訊息成功機率，檢查相關遮蔽對重送效益的破壞。
related.differenceEn: Estimate delivery success over independent attempts and examine how correlated blockage weakens retries.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成太陽照度 1360 W/m²、受照面積 10 m²、吸收率 0.6、正對太陽。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Q=0.6×1360×10。 結果約 8160 W。直接日照吸熱 Q=αSAcosθ；只算外部輸入，不等於艙內溫度。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學單次成功率 0.8，最多嘗試 3 次，訊息內容相同且可去重。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：P交付=1−0.2³。 結果約 0.992 fraction。每次成功率 p，最多 n 次至少成功一次的機率=1−(1−p)^n；同一持續中斷期間不獨立。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic irradiance is 1360 W/m², exposed area 10 m², absorptivity 0.6 and normal incidence. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Q=0.6×1360×10. Result ≈ 8160 W. Direct solar absorption Q=αSAcosθ calculates input only, not cabin temperature.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching single-attempt success 0.8, at most three attempts and a deduplicatable message. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Pdelivery=1−0.2³. Result ≈ 0.992 fraction. With success p per attempt, success within n attempts is 1−(1−p)^n; attempts during one persistent outage are not independent.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
